mn33:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn33:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn33:2.1: Ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ,
mn33:2.3: Idha bhikkhave gopālako na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
mn33:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ.
mn33:3.1: Evam-eva kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ,
mn33:3.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
mn33:4.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti:
mn33:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ sabbaṃ rūpaṃ cattāri mahābhūtāni catunnañ-ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpan-ti yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti.
mn33:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti.
mn33:5.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti:
mn33:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu: kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito ti yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti.
mn33:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.
mn33:6.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti:
mn33:6.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti, uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ --pe-- uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ -- uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme adhivāseti na-ppajahati na vinodeti na byantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn33:6.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti.
mn33:7.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti:
mn33:7.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī,
mn33:7.3: yatvādhikaraṇam-enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn33:7.9: yatvādhikaraṇam-enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn33:7.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti.
mn33:8.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti:
mn33:8.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ na vitthārena paresaṃ desetā hoti.
mn33:8.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti.
mn33:9.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti:
mn33:9.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā na paripucchati na paripañhati:
mn33:9.5: Tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ-c' eva na vivaranti, anuttānikatañ-ca na uttānikaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhānīyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ na paṭivinodenti.
mn33:9.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti.
mn33:10.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti:
mn33:10.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na labhati atthavedaṃ, na labhati dhammavedaṃ, na labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
mn33:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti.
mn33:11.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti:
mn33:11.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti.
mn33:11.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti.
mn33:12.1: Kathañ-ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti:
mn33:12.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti.
mn33:12.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti. \ [...
